command: set -u; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; echo '===VOICE_UNIT==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '===CHATGPT_CLIENT_UNIT==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '===OMEGA_BIN==='; command -v omega || true; if command -v omega >/dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$(command -v omega)"; omega status 2>&1 || true; fi; echo '===FINAL_VOICE_DISCOVERY==='; v=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart --value 2>/dev/null || true); p=$(printf '%s' "$v" | grep -oE '/[^ ;{}"'''']*voice_final_runtime\.py' | head -n1 || true); printf 'voice_script=%s\n' "$p"; if [ -n "$p" ] && [ -f "$p" ]; then d=$(dirname "$p"); sha256sum "$p" "$d/voice_full_runtime.py" "$d/omega_runtime.py" "$d/frankenstein_identity_assembly.py" 2>&1 || true; fi
